edits.new: No table of another service is read, and `dp_treatment`, `dp_guarantee_claim` and `data_product_load` are not created, read or written here (DP-01). The dated copy `dp_treatment` is P1's data engine: it is built from this service's events and read only for reporting, never as the source of a treatment; the live `treatment` row of `rwb_treatment` is the only treatment record this story reads (GAP-1716).

edits.old: and `TreatmentWorkflow` on queue `rwb-treatment` belongs to RWB-S2-E2004-APP (DP-10).
edits.new: and `TreatmentWorkflow` on queue `rwb-treatment` belongs to RWB-S2-E2004-APP (DP-10). The workflow is `Stage2ProductWorkflow` on queue `rwb-source-data` in namespace `rwb-recovery`, with activities `snapshot(page)`, `writeDp04Page`, `checkActiveCount` and `stampDp04`, started by `rwb.source-data.AceDataReady.v1` (GAP-0510). The DP04 expected-by time is 08:00, carried from decision log row DL11 until the data steward records it in the `data_product` row (GAP-0511). Every deployment value, threshold and timing is a named chart value set per environment, and the fixture owner is named at the wave 2 entry check (GAP-0513).

edits.new:
Then the consumer's step fails on its own side, where MSG-GEN-006 names system "Treatment"

  Scenario: AC9 The two reads hold no write statement, no outbox write and no publish (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the code of the two reads and a scan of the code of this service
    When the guardrail scan runs
    Then no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or MERGE statement is found in the code of the two reads
    Then no outbox row is written and no event is published on rwb.treatment.events.v1 by either read
    Then the guardrail fails a build that declares any of them

  Scenario: AC10 A call without a valid credential, or to a path no operation provides, is answered 401 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller presents no valid credential, or a path under /api/recovery/treatment/v1 that no operation provides
    When the caller calls that path
    Then the answer is 401 for the missing credential and 404 for the unknown path, with no items
    Then no treatment of the window is returned with either answer
